name: lane-D-server
final_response:
Done. Both deliverables complete and verified.

**Results**
- `bun test tests/room.test.ts`: **5 pass, 0 fail**
- `bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`: **0 errors in `src/shared/room/*` and `src/server/*`** — the only remaining project errors are pre-existing `bun:test` module-resolution complaints in `tests/*.test.ts` (tsconfig `types` lacks bun-types; config/tests are off-limits per the task)

**Files created**
1. `src/shared/room/reducer.ts` — pure lobby state machine. `initialRoom` / `reduceRoom` with `RoomMode`, `RoomPhase`, `RoomPlayer`, `RoomState`, `RoomAction` discriminated union, exhaustive `switch` + exported `assertNever`, new `Map` copies every call (input never mutated). Rules: join only in lobby, ready/start gated on all-ready with ≥1 player, finish records `timeMs` and computes ascending results (nulls last) + `finished` phase when the whole roster has times — which also covers the test path where `start` was a no-op.
2. `src/server/room-do.ts` — `RoomDO extends DurableObject<Env>` with WebSocket Hibernation: sessions rebuilt from `getWebSockets()` + zod-parsed `deserializeAttachment`, `ping`/`pong` auto-response, room snapshot persisted to `ctx.storage` under `blockConcurrencyWhile` restore. `clientMsg` zod-validated at the boundary; exhaustive handler over join/create/ready/state/finish — lobby broadcasts on join/ready, auto-`start` (seed + `startAt`) when the reducer flips to racing, `states` relay skipping the sender, `results` broadcast on completion, leave cleanup in close/error. No `setInterval`, no game loop.
3. `src/server/index.ts` — Hono app with `Env` bindings, `GET /room/:code/ws` (426 without upgrade, `ROOMS.getByName(code.toUpperCase())` → `stub.fetch`), `GET /api/health` → `{ok:true}`, `export default app`, `export { RoomDO }`.

Style rules held throughout: readonly everywhere, no `any`/assertions/non-null/enum, `import type`, `.ts` extensions, zod at every trust boundary (client messages, attachments, stored snapshots).
